===== TEXT =====
Vision Government Solutions

|

MANCHESTER,CT

|

Welcome

The Town of Manchester
contracted with Vision Government to assist with the 2021 state mandated
revaluation project. Both the Assessor's
Office and Vision Government Solutions would like to thank Town of Manchester
residents for their patience and cooperation throughout the 2021 Revaluation
project.

Shown on this site are assessments of all
taxable and exempt properties based on 70% of market value as of October 1, 2021.
The previous assessments were as of October 1, 2016.

Please
note that assessed values do not reflect any exemptions, which will be applied
to the final assessments.

Please do not use the current mill rate to
estimate your taxes. A new mill rate
will be established once the grand list is finalized and the budget completed.

(c) 2026 Vision Government Solutions, Inc. All rights reserved.
